visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short reddish-brown hair and glasses, wearing a sleeveless grey top and a silver watch, speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor office. She uses an OK hand gesture and points towards her head. The background features clinical certificates on the wall and a white medical chair. (2) Close-up comparison shots of a person's nose and cheek area are shown. The top image is labeled BEFORE and the bottom AFTER, with a red circle highlighting reduced redness and smoother skin texture. The woman's arm is visible on the left side of the frame. (3) The woman returns to full view, speaking animatedly and gesturing with her hands. Pink heart graphics appear around her. She touches her neck and shoulders while talking. (4) A final static graphic screen appears with a white and grey textured background. It displays the clinic's logo, social media handles, a phone number, and two specific addresses in Traditional Chinese characters.

Subdued 'pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects are used for transition between visual segments. The BGM remains constant in volume and tempo. The music continues at the same steady intensity throughout the contact information section before finally fading out at the end of the recording.
